blacksmith.description: The Blacksmith provides your armies with Supply Carts.
blacksmith.name: Blacksmith

capitol.description: The Capitol earns your kingdom 4000 gold per day.
capitol.name: Capitol

castle.description: The Castle adds two arrow towers, fortifies your town's defenses, and doubles base creature growth.
castle.name: Castle

citadel.description: Including a 50% increase to base creature growth, the Citadel adds a keep, and other terrain obstacles, to a town's defenses.
citadel.name: Citadel

cityHall.description: The City Hall allows you to purchase town structures and earns your kingdom 2000 gold per day.
cityHall.name: City Hall

dwellingLvl1.description: The Post allows you to recruit Shield Bearers.
dwellingLvl1.name: Post

dwellingLvl2.description: The Proving Grounds allow you to recruit Thugs.
dwellingLvl2.name: Proving Grounds

dwellingLvl3.description: The Lava Basin allows you to recruit Arsonists.
dwellingLvl3.name: Lava Basin

dwellingLvl3B.description: The Reanimatorium allows you to recruit Bionic Troopers.
dwellingLvl3B.name: Reanimatorium

dwellingLvl4.description: The Suckers Colony allows you to recruit Brain Suckers.
dwellingLvl4.name: Suckers Colony

dwellingLvl5.description: The Cannoneers Shelters allow you to recruit Cannoneers.
dwellingLvl5.name: Cannoneers Shelters

dwellingLvl6.description: The Borough allows you to recruit Sky Brawlers.
dwellingLvl6.name: Borough

dwellingLvl7.description: The Juggernauts Pit allows you to recruit Juggernauts.
dwellingLvl7.name: Juggernauts Pit

dwellingUpLvl1.description: The Post allows you to recruit Pavise Bearers.
dwellingUpLvl1.name: Upg. Post

dwellingUpLvl2.description: The Proving Grounds allow you to recruit Mercenaries.
dwellingUpLvl2.name: Upg. Proving Grounds

dwellingUpLvl3.description: The Lava Basin allows you to recruit Pyromaniacs.
dwellingUpLvl3.name: Upg. Lava Basin

dwellingUpLvl3B.description: The Reanimatorium allows you to recruit Cyborgs.
dwellingUpLvl3B.name: Upg. Reanimatorium

dwellingUpLvl4.description: The Suckers Colony allows you to recruite Soul Suckers.
dwellingUpLvl4.name: Upg. Suckers Colony

dwellingUpLvl5.description: The Cannoneers Shelters allow you to recruit Bombardiers.
dwellingUpLvl5.name: Upg. Cannoneers Shelters

dwellingUpLvl6.description: The Borough allows you to recruit Sky Knights.
dwellingUpLvl6.name: Upg. Borough

dwellingUpLvl7.description: The Juggernauts Pit allows you to recruit Dreadnoughts.
dwellingUpLvl7.name: Upg. Juggernauts Pit

fort.description: The Fort provides your town with defensive walls.
fort.name: Fort

grail.description: The presence of the Tesla Coil increases weekly creature generation by 50% and provides your kingdom with an additional 5000 gold each day.
grail.name: Tesla Coil

horde1.description: The Turret increases Shield Bearers production by 6 per week.
horde1.name: Turret

horde1Upgr.description: The Turret increases Pavise Bearers production by 6 per week.
horde1Upgr.name: Turret

horde2.description: The Arsenal increases Sky Brawlers production by 1 per week.
horde2.name: Arsenal

horde2Upgr.description: The Arsenal increases Sky Knights production by 1 per week.
horde2Upgr.name: Arsenal

mageGuild1.description: Entering the Mage Guild will allow a visiting hero to learn the spells kept within.
mageGuild1.name: Mage Guild Level 1

mageGuild2.description: Entering the Mage Guild will allow a visiting hero to learn the spells kept within.
mageGuild2.name: Mage Guild Level 2

mageGuild3.description: Entering the Mage Guild will allow a visiting hero to learn the spells kept within.
mageGuild3.name: Mage Guild Level 3

marketplace.description: With the Marketplace, you can buy and sell resources (exchange rates increase with each Marketplace you own).
marketplace.name: Marketplace

resourceSilo.description: The Resource Silo provides you with an additional wood and ore each day.
resourceSilo.name: Resource Silo

special1.description: The Replicator allows you to replicate Artifacts (not working for all artifacts yet).
special1.name: Replicator
